page_title: ROM 1-1 FIO | AS Roma v Fiorentina 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' The match is over and Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) gets a red card for unsporting behaviour.
90+6' Yellow card. Diego Llorente (AS Roma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+5' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
90+4' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

90+2' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
90+1' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a chip pass into the box, but Rui Patricio is quickest to intercept the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
89' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) picks up a pass, lines up a shot and strikes from 20 metres out, but Rui Patricio thwarts the effort which is headed low to the middle of the goal.
88' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
87' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
86' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
86' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
85' Substitution. Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Pellegrini walks off.
84' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
84' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
83' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
82' The foul by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
82' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
81' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Fiorentina win a corner.
81' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Michael Kayode is replaced by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
80' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
78' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
78' A substitution has been made. Giacomo Bonaventura goes off and Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) comes on.
77' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
76' 1:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
75' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
75' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) gets booked.

74' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Rui Patricio displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
74' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
74' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

73' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top right corner. Rui Patricio shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.
72' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and it's Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
72' Here's the change. Jonathan Ikone leaves the pitch and Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
72' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
71' The Fiorentina players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
69' The ball is cleared after Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Kouame is the provider and Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the bottom right corner from close in with his head. 1:1.
64' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
64' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!

64' What a chance that is! Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar!
63' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
63' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
63' A cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
62' Jose Mourinho has decided to make a change. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replaces Sardar Azmoun.
59' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
59' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina). The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
59' Antonio Rapuano blows the whistle, Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Free kick. Fiorentina will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
55' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
54' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
53' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
53' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) will take the corner.
52' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
50' A pass into the box finds Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Rui Patricio denies him.
47' A cross into the box from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared.
47' Rough tackle by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires a low shot from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Rui Patricio is equal to it.

45+2' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
43' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
41' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
41' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
37' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
37' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

36' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
34' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) produces a cunning chipped pass for Giacomo Bonaventura, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
34' The ball possession is 43:57.
34' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
32' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' It looks like M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Antonio Rapuano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
28' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
26' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
25' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick, but Rui Patricio reads it well and stops the effort.
25' A lofted cross from Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
25' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Paulo Dybala limps off the pitch to be replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
23' It doesn’t look good for Paulo Dybala (AS Roma); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!

22' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
19' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina).

17' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Patricio pulls off a great save to deny him.
16' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) and Paulo Dybala attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
15' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

14' Nicola Zalewski pulls the ball back to Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
10' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pietro Terracciano, who smothers the ball.
8' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
7' The free kick into the penalty area from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
7' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle after Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala swings the ball deep into the box and finds Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
4' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
